supersedes: Original receipt-u2.json separate role persistence/publication and RoleError::Publication assumptions are withdrawn by prime ruling. HTTP requests/responses and RoleService constructor/method/RoleReceipt signatures remain unchanged.

delta.base: Previously handed u2-source.patch, SHA256 de5e1fc10af27eacec3113c77a1b9c9ff36809a37a02e81b34d1a851969b7e45; NOT the repository baseline
excluded: earlier u2 changes outside the bounded atomic slice

verification.reason: Source-only amendment: PM owns validation at barrier. No build, test, formatter, linter, commit or teardown run.

implementation: RoleService clones registry/store/clock and actor/target into an owned static async callback passed to EventBus::publish_committed. Authority and clock are read only after shared publication admission, not before waiting for the lock.
The local role-only mutex is removed. Registry and role writes share bus ordering. Caller/target liveness and current parent are re-read inside that boundary.

SqliteOrchestration::assert_role_committed performs one BEGIN IMMEDIATE, role upsert or targeted delete, append_in_transaction, and transaction commit. It sets Event.seq to the real returned sequence only after commit. Failed mutation/append explicitly rolls back.

The callback derives the existing RoleReceipt from the committed Event.seq and returns (Event, RoleReceipt). It never invokes EventBus recursively. The bus owns ordering/cancellation retention/broadcast.

GovernanceRefused {code,record} maps by typed code: E-RS-OWNERSHIP uses parent id or literal absent to construct existing RoleError::Ownership. Other governance refusals map to invalid. No message/prose parsing.
RoleError::Publication and its E-RS-PARTIAL response branch are removed. Store failures refuse without retaining a partial role row/event pair.

Role service tests now use SqliteRegistry, SqliteSpine, SqliteOrchestration and EventBus sharing one actual SQLite pool; no independent FakeSpine. Existing HTTP and CLI contract tests remain unchanged.

store_api.signature: pub async fn assert_role_committed(&self, actor: &SeatId, target: &SeatId, role: Option<&str>, assigned_at: u64) -> pij_core::error::Result<Event>
invariants: Caller holds shared publication boundary from authority read through commit.
Store pool is the same SQLite pool behind bus raw spine.
append_in_transaction remains the sole SQL spine INSERT location.
Role row and role-set event commit atomically; every explicit successful set/unset emits an event, including same-value set and absent-row unset.
This helper commits but never broadcasts; EventBus broadcasts its returned committed event.

pm_wiring.change: Add `mod role_assertion;` (private module suffices: it adds public inherent methods to existing exported SqliteOrchestration).

Keep PM/u3 pub(crate) pool: Pool<Sqlite> and Clone derivation. Existing seat_role/list_roles/clear_role remain; service no longer calls assign_role/clear_role for mutation. No source hunk for this shared file in delta.
Keep u1 pub(crate) append_in_transaction(&mut SqliteConnection,&Event)->Result<Seq>; no new INSERT site.
Keep shared PijError::GovernanceRefused {code:String,record:String}; ownership record is parent id or literal absent.
Keep cancellation-safe owned/static publish_committed<T,F>(&self,F)->Result<(Seq,T)> where F:Future<Output=Result<(Event,T)>>+Send+'static, T:Send+'static; lock before polling.

No constructor changes: supply same registry Arc, same bus Arc, and same real/in-memory StorePool. RoleService still exposes assert_role/read_role/join_roles. u3 routes continue calling assert_role and error.into_response.

failure_injection: An isolated SQL BEFORE INSERT ON spine_events trigger raises ABORT after the role upsert/delete. Four witnesses assert the complete previous RoleAssignment/absence, durable event list and live subscriber remain unchanged. Cancellation witness holds an independent SQL writer until request cancellation, releases it, then flushes the bus and checks committed role/event. Authority witness queues a role request behind an earlier controlled registry publication, changes parent, then requires current-parent refusal.
assumptions: Every competing registry/governance mutation uses the same publication boundary; direct SQL external writers are outside the daemon ordering protocol.

No callback recursively calls EventBus. The authority test's controlled gate uses the raw SqliteSpine adapter only to publish the fixture's preceding registry snapshot through the admitted outer boundary.
u1 cancellation safety persists through a dropped request after admission, not abrupt process/runtime termination. Drain producers and bus per u1 shutdown recipe.

Registration descriptor admission and subsequent role assertion remain distinct operations. Existing registration error wording may describe already-admitted descriptor plus failed atomic role assertion; there is no partial role row/event exception.

Delta applies against exact prior u2 source, while PM composition may have formatted or lightly changed shared captures. PM resolves only necessary context at convergence; no full-baseline patch replay.
No validation performed; compile/runtime correctness awaits PM's actual proof.
